brief:
Morocco's Justice and Development Party renewed its rejection of all forms of normalization, relations, and agreements with Israel, asserting its position on the matter is "firm and steadfast," Shehab Wire reported. The statement followed circulating reports of a meeting between Moroccan Foreign Minister Nasser Bourita and Israeli officials.

The party, a major political force in Morocco, maintained its long-standing opposition to any diplomatic or economic ties with Israel amid ongoing Palestinian-Israeli tensions.
